title: Forward Networks Unlimited Enterprise License
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE INFORMATION SYSTEMS AGENCY (DISA).IT CONTRACTING DIVISION - PL84
description_text:
The purpose of Amendment 0001 is as follows:

A. Update Attachment 9_RFP Questions and Answers_Amend 0001 to provide answers to questions.

B. Update Attachment 1_PWS_Amend 0001 based on responses to questions. 

C. Update Attachment 4, CDRLS_Exhibit A_Amend 0001

D. Response due date remains July 17, 2026 by 8am Central.

Questions are due by 8am Central on Friday, July 10, 2026.

Proposals are due by 8am Central on Friday, July 17, 2026.

The purpose of this solicitation is to procure a Forward Networks Enterprise License (EL) that transitions DISA from a restrictive, decentralized licensing model to a centrally managed, unlimited-use software EL. This transition will establish a predictable, flat-rate pricing structure, eliminating per-device financial penalties and providing the unrestricted scalability required to support the DoD Information Network’s (DoDIN’s) exponential devices growth. Furthermore, the contract aims to ensure mission readiness by delivering the critical network modeling and predictive verification capabilities necessary to secure advanced Artificial Intelligence enclaves, in direct alignment with the Presidential Executive Order on Artificial Intelligence. Finally, by deploying dedicated Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) Resident Engineering support, the Government will accelerate the integration of the digital twin, automate Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) compliance, and create a unified, queryable operational picture across DISA’s complex, multi-vendor environment.
